evidence_note: News report on a lawmaker's donation says only two dialysis centres work in the whole state. Neither centre is named. "only two dialysis centres are functional in Abia State."
The same article says the centre at an unnamed major facility runs only some of the time. No cause is given. "the dialysis centre at a major health facility in the state now operates irregularly."

facility_name: Nenu Specialist Hospital, Obingwa LGA
evidence_note: A lawmaker donated four machines. The article does not say whether they are installed or working. "has donated critical medical equipment, including four dialysis machines, to Nenu Specialist Hospital."

facility_name: New hospital building, old Aba General Hospital premises
evidence_note: The building was still under construction at the governor's inspection. Seventeen machines were said to be 'already on' site, plus more not counted. "This Medical Facility will have provisions for Dialysis with 17 brand new Dialysis Machines already on and several others."

facility_name: Enoch and Folu Adeboye Dialysis Centre, Comprehensive Medical Centre, Awkuzu
evidence_note: A church charity (RCCG's His Love Foundation) donated the centre in 2022, along with a reverse-osmosis water system. The sentence on three machines may cover both the Awkuzu and Enugu centres together. "having three units of dialysis machines, a medical water reserve osmosis purification system in both centres"

facility_name: Enoch and Folu Adeboye Dialysis Centre, Comprehensive Medical Centre, Awkuzu
evidence_note: A 2026 article, citing the foundation's 2022 record, lists Awkuzu as still waiting to be commissioned. This conflicts with the 2022 report that it was 'inaugurated'. "awaiting commissioning"

facility_name: David Umahi Federal University Teaching Hospital (DUFUTH), Uburu
evidence_note: The hospital started a one-month programme of dialysis at no charge to patients at a newly opened renal centre. A consultant nephrologist heads the renal unit. No machine count is given. "recently activated ultramodern renal centre"

facility_name: Federal Medical Centre, Abakaliki
evidence_note: Listed as one of the 11 federal hospitals in the N12,000-per-session dialysis subsidy. No machine count or status for this hospital. "The scheme is currently running in 11 federal tertiary health facilities."

facility_name: Enoch and Folu Adeboye Dialysis Centre, University of Nigeria Teaching Hospital (UNTH), Enugu
evidence_note: RCCG's charity reported in 2022 that it had opened a centre at UNTH, with machines, a reverse-osmosis water system and a 30KVA generator. The three-machine figure may be shared with Awkuzu. "has inaugurated the Enoch and Folu Adeboye Dialysis Centre University of Nigeria Teaching Hospital Enugu"

facility_name: Enoch and Folu Adeboye Dialysis Centre, University of Nigeria Teaching Hospital (UNTH), Enugu
evidence_note: A 2026 article, citing the foundation's 2022 record, lists the UNTH Enugu centre as still waiting to be commissioned. This conflicts with the 2022 'inaugurated' report. "awaiting commissioning"

facility_name: University of Nigeria Teaching Hospital (UNTH), Enugu
evidence_note: The hospital's own site shows it has a Nephrology Department, which held a 2024 World Kidney Day event. No headcount and nothing on dialysis machines. "The Nephrology Department of the University of Nigeria Teaching Hospital"

facility_name: Federal Teaching Hospital, Owerri
evidence_note: The hospital began running the federal N12,000-per-session subsidy. A hospital nephrologist is quoted. No machine count. "commenced the implementation of the subsidy"

facility_name: Imo State University Teaching Hospital (IMSUTH), Orlu
evidence_note: The chief medical director listed dialysis machines among new equipment from the state government. No count and no working status. "He listed the new equipment to include Digital X-ray machines, Mammogram machine, Ambulance, Dialysis machines"

facility_name: Enoch and Folu Adeboye Dialysis Centre, Immanuel General Hospital, Eket
evidence_note: RCCG donated three machines to this state-owned hospital. The governor warned about having no staff to run them and ordered staff to be deployed. "We don't want to have equipment here, yet we don't have the manpower to operate them."

facility_name: General Hospital, Ikot Ekpene
evidence_note: State government commissioned a new haemodialysis unit and plans units in all 10 federal constituencies. No machine count. "plans to establish Hemodialysis Units across all 10 federal constituencies"

facility_name: University of Uyo Teaching Hospital (UUTH)
evidence_note: A UUTH kidney specialist said dialysis was too costly for most patients. This is a payment barrier. "it could cost up to N500, 000 for four sessions of dialysis and not many people can afford it."

facility_name: University of Uyo Teaching Hospital (UUTH)
evidence_note: Study of the centre's first year (2008-09). Patients' lack of money was the top reason they had no permanent vascular access. The authors note that national health insurance (NHIS) excluded chronic renal disease. "Unavailability of fund on the part of the patients ranked highest."

facility_name: Federal Medical Centre, Yenagoa
evidence_note: The subsidy had not started because some materials had not arrived. The CMD named power supply as the main problem. A consultant nephrologist and a renal unit head are quoted. "power supply is the major challenge being faced."

facility_name: Bayelsa State Haemodialysis Centre, Bayelsa Medical University, Yenagoa
evidence_note: The governor opened a state haemodialysis centre. No machine count, and the article suggests operations had not yet begun. "has inaugurated a state-of-the-art haemodialysis and general out-patient centre"

facility_name: General Hospital, Ogoja (proposed kidney centre)
evidence_note: The state approved funds for a dialysis centre because northern Cross River has no functional referral centre. Patients travel to Makurdi, Abakaliki and Calabar. "the absence of a functional dialysis referral centre in the northern part of the state."

facility_name: Delta State University Teaching Hospital (DELSUTH), Oghara
evidence_note: Three new Fresenius machines were added and the old machines repaired. A new water treatment unit was installed, and the dialysis services, which had stopped, were restarted. "three brand new Fresenius dialysis machine"

The state approved buying eight 'dialyzers' for state hospitals and a plan to cut the session price from over N70,000 to N45,000. The article does not say whether these are dialysis machines. "approved the procurement of eight new dialyzers for government hospitals across the state."

facility_name: Enoch and Folu Adeboye Dialysis Centre, Federal Medical Centre, Asaba
evidence_note: An RCCG-donated centre was due to be commissioned on 24 September 2026. No machine count, and the commissioning is not confirmed. "will be officially commissioned on Thursday, September 24, 2026, at 11:00 a.m."

facility_name: University of Benin Teaching Hospital (UBTH)
evidence_note: UBTH received three donated machines on 2 September 2026. "received three complete dialysis machines donated through His Love Foundation"

facility_name: University of Benin Teaching Hospital (UBTH)
evidence_note: A patient said only two machines served the subsidy scheme, far too few for demand. This is the patient's claim and the reporter did not verify it. Date is approximate: the page showed '6 months ago'. "They brought just two machines. Two machines for over 400 patients."

A UBTH consultant nephrologist said Benin City has about four centres, all at full capacity. The same article later says five, so a second row may be warranted. "there are about four dialysis centres in Benin that equally operate at full capacity."

The same article gives a second, conflicting count of five centres working at full capacity in Benin. "there are five dialysis centres working at full capacity as the number of patients is on the increase"

facility_name: University of Port Harcourt Teaching Hospital (UPTH)
evidence_note: The Nephrology Department was being refurbished. The article says both that the machines were installed and that installation was still going on. "six dialysis machines have been installed at the hospital."

facility_name: University of Port Harcourt Teaching Hospital (UPTH)
evidence_note: The International Society of Nephrology says haemodialysis in Port Harcourt was inadequate before a 2017 partnership with Salford Royal Hospital, UK. No cause is given. "inadequate hemodialysis"

facility_name: The Renal Centre, Rivers State University Teaching Hospital (RSUTH)
evidence_note: The hospital's own site announces new renal services: peritoneal dialysis, continuous kidney replacement therapy and plasma exchange. A paediatric nephrologist heads the centre. No machine count. "Automated Peritoneal Dialysis for adults and children"
